kits.title: Acorn Avenue Tiny Errand Pack
kits.parentNote: Use one errand card at a time and let the child answer with fragments, labels, or full sentences before building a short story.
kits.classroomExtension: Set up three desk stations as tiny neighbors, then have pairs trade route maps and check whether the directions are clear.
kits.upsell: $29 lower-grade neighborhood writing bundle with six more civic errand maps and reusable route cards.

kits.title: Teacup Town Weather Writing Bundle
kits.parentNote: Start with real weather outside, then have the child transfer one detail into Teacup Town before writing the errand.
kits.classroomExtension: Create a shared forecast board and let small groups revise one mixed-up shop notice for clarity.
kits.upsell: $79 classroom weather-and-map writing pack with station signs, rubric, and extension tasks.

kits.title: Pocket Park Notice Board Classroom Pack
pages: Seed Swap and Picnic Errand Cards
Teacher Guide: Civic Notes Without Lectures
kits.parentNote: For home use, pick two notice templates and ask the child to make each one clearer, shorter, or kinder.
kits.classroomExtension: Assign park roles, rotate the notice board, and have students rewrite unclear messages into useful directions.
kits.upsell: $79 license includes permission to print for one classroom plus the follow-up Parcel Day symbol-key activity.

kits.title: Rain Boot Route Rangers Weather Pack
kits.parentNote: Let the child move route cards by hand before writing so the story problem feels like a small puzzle, not a blank page.
kits.classroomExtension: Use the route cards as a sequencing center, then ask students to explain why their final route works.
kits.upsell: $79 classroom route-planning collection with extra maps for mail, snacks, weather, and shop errands.
